name: Clear Component Store
description: Removes superseded Windows update components to free up disk space in the WinSxS folder without breaking system updates.

description_i18n.en: Removes superseded Windows update components to free up disk space in the WinSxS folder without breaking system updates.
description_i18n.de: Entfernt veraltete Update-Komponenten, um Speicherplatz im WinSxS-Ordner zu sparen, ohne Systemupdates zu beeinträchtigen.
description_i18n.fr: Supprime les composants de mise à jour obsolètes pour libérer de l'espace disque dans le dossier WinSxS sans rompre les mises à jour système.

warnings.title: Disk Activity Spike
warnings.message: The cleanup process will temporarily increase CPU usage and disk activity. Do not interrupt the script while it is running

warnings.title: No Performance Gain
warnings.message: This action does not increase raw internet speed, lower ping, or improve gaming latency. It only recovers disk space

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Executes DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /StartComponentCleanup to remove superseded components and update leftovers from the Windows component store
